name: Item Template
query:
SELECT
    i.item_code AS "Item Code:Link/Item:120",
    i.item_name AS "Item Name (Full Commercial/Chem):Data:250",
    i.item_group AS "Category (Medicine / Consumable ):Data:180",
    i.stock_uom AS "Unit of Measure:Data:100",
    b.valuation_rate AS "Average Cost per Unit:Currency:120",
    b.actual_qty AS "Stock on Hand (Qty):Float:120",
    ip.price_list_rate AS "Selling Price:Currency:120",
    '' AS "Comments (If Necessary):Data:200"
FROM
    `tabItem` i
LEFT JOIN
    `tabBin` b 
      ON b.item_code = i.name 
LEFT JOIN
    `tabItem Price` ip 
      ON ip.item_code = i.name 
WHERE
    i.disabled = 0 AND is_stock_item = 1
ORDER BY
    i.item_code;
